title: elymus violaceus
intro: Elymus violaceus, commonly known as purple wheat grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve antioxidant levels, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Elymus violaceus include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which may help to protect against chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of Elymus violaceus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
